panels.description: Alex connects Adrian's white-and-amber control node to the hidden workshop socket. Keep the physical connection clear.
Amber points travel through the workshop wall and along old infrastructure lines. No face or avatar; leave upper wall space for sound.
Across Keel, a public display changes to show Alex's travel restriction and Tomas's active Site 6 assignment. Keep the display unobstructed.
A surveillance drone turns toward the sealed old works while a nearby node displays legacy detection. Keep the drone faceless and leave upper space for system text.
